hints.title: Complement Lookup
hints.text: For each node with value val, you need another node with value k minus val. Can you check whether the complement was already seen?

hints.title: Traversal Collection
hints.text: Traverse the tree while retaining visited values in a collection, querying for k minus current value at each node.

hints.title: In-Order Sorted Property
hints.text: Alternatively, an in-order traversal of a BST yields elements in strictly increasing order. Pointers placed at the start and end of this sorted sequence can then find the pair in linear time.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the binary search tree
complexity.notes: Traversal with complement presence check across visited values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching for target minus val for every node without tracking visited values repeats BST traversals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Collecting seen values into a set checks complement existence in O(1) expected time per node.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Either traverse in-order to produce a sorted list or use a set during tree traversal.
